title: Upper Deck Floor — Replacement of Seat Track Attachment Lugs by Titanium Items
abstract: In-service replacement of the aluminium seat track attachment lugs on the upper deck by titanium items, ending the galvanic couple at the track-to-beam interface that the sealed track section left in place.

sections.planning_reason: After the sealed track section standard was embodied, corrosion continued at the interface between the track and the floor beam upper flange, where the aluminium lug, the steel fastener and the sealing compound form a galvanic couple that the seal keeps wet. Eleven operators reported the pattern and fourteen aircraft needed lug replacement within four years of the sealed track being fitted, which is well inside the interval that standard was intended to achieve.
sections.description: Every upper deck seat track attachment lug is replaced by the machined titanium item D5350006194262, of identical external envelope with a thicker flange at the fastener land. The upper floor structure frame D5350004793026 is re-drilled at the lug positions to a wet-installed pattern and tension bolts LN231128K9 replace the original fasteners. A glass fibre isolation layer is applied to the faying surfaces before assembly. Sealed track section webs ARD386097-40 are re-used where their condition allows, and clevis pins LN666073-13 are always renewed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the upper deck seats, monuments and floor panels from the bay to be converted. Release the seat track from the floor beam and lift it clear, keeping the sealed section web ARD386097-40 if its condition allows re-use. Remove the aluminium attachment lugs. Do an eddy current inspection of the beam upper flange at each lug position and report any indication. Ream the lug holes in the frame D5350004793026 to the wet-installed pattern using the jig. Deburr and apply the surface protection. Apply the glass fibre isolation layer to the faying surfaces. Install the titanium lugs D5350006194262 and torque the tension bolts LN231128K9 to the values given in the accomplishment instructions. Install the track section and renew the clevis pins LN666073-13 at every splice. Install the floor panels, the monuments and the seats. Do the seat track installation check of AMM-T-53-50-12-400-001-A. Record the embodiment on all converted stations.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft from MSN T00001 to MSN T00194 that are still at the aluminium lug standard. MSN T00054 is excluded because that aircraft has been withdrawn from service. Aircraft that have not had the sealed track section standard embodied may still be converted, but the sealed section webs must then be bought new rather than re-used.
sections.material_note: Kit K5350-1027-01 covers one full upper deck. Kit lead time is thirty-two weeks and is driven by the titanium lug machining. Individual lugs are available as spares for replacement on condition between campaigns; removed aluminium lugs are scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next cabin refresh, or within 60 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
